annotations.title: Find a travel company's official booking site (read-only)

description: Use this when a traveler asks how or where to book with a named airline, ferry, hotel, vehicle-rental or booking company. Returns its official site and booking page and, where listed, its own booking channels (app, API, MCP), dated rules with sources and what the traveler does personally. Flags sites not on the company's listed domains. It does not search fares or availability, or book.

where.description: Company or site, or page URL without its query
